proofs.run: for each of the six hidden runs (proofs 0 to 5): count the stdout lines of the form '<label> pass|fail|unjudged <detail>' and compare with N of the summary line 'N checks, F failed, U not judged' of the same run; they must be equal

gap: S, the proof is by absence on the mutant side: the red of a mutant here is 'the log of the hidden run holds no case line' (proof 0..5 pass regex fails: there is no '<label> pass ...' line), so each mutant's red field is the empty-line placeholder '^$' and the runner must read 'the proof's pass line is missing' as red. The deciding values on each line come from the check's own detail (journeys/lib/harness.py case_line :288 cuts it at 300 characters): a case whose detail is empty prints a line with no values: the lead reads one line per check for values, e.g. in par-quickreply the landing-light case. 'a mutant run prints its red line per case' is the selftest of each check (print_model_cases for the clean model, then 'mutant <case> -> RED' lines): proofs 6 to 11; their pass lines differ per check (listed in the proofs), taken from the last lines of the main81 self-test logs and not verified at this commit (the macshell one is 'MUTANTS | caps not-above-the-frame | ok | 5 bad' there, a table row, not a summary).
